en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside scene with a church and a weir. On the left stands a tall church with a clock tower and spire, surrounded by trees and adjacent buildings. In the foreground, water cascades smoothly over a wide weir or low dam. The scene is framed by trees along the riverbank, under a partly cloudy sky. Handwritten captions appear along the lower edge.
